question: Is ten refinement levels (finest micro step h/512) a safe default change for sampler::Tuning::default() (currently eight, h/128)?
motivation: WP66 (STUDIES/funnel_tail_deficit_v1): Tuning::default().max_refinement_levels(10) cut funnel retained divergences 59 -> 1 and exhaustions 756 -> 10 over 30 seeds with the tail mass unchanged in sign (paired -0.0012 +/- 0.0007) and draw-identical cells on Eight Schools and a 100-D Gaussian.
library_under_test: wt/funnel-tail on top of main 5af9903e (= a49df800 library + WP66 study). One library change, behind a Cargo feature that is off by default: feature `candidate-levels10` makes sampler::DEFAULT_MAX_REFINEMENT_LEVELS (used by Tuning::default()) 10 instead of 8; tests/sampler_api.rs gains default_refinement_levels_follow_the_candidate_feature. With the feature off the library is the main library plus a public constant equal to 8.
flip_note: A flip (making 10 the unconditional default) is NOT applied here. By the project's precedent it would not advance ALGORITHM_REVISION or change tests/kernel_fingerprint.rs: both pin walnutpie::KernelTuning (the frozen replay tuning with explicit level counts), not sampler::Tuning::default(), exactly as the MomentumSum (WP31/32), RejectLeaf (WP54) and best-of-16 (WP52) sampler-default flips left them unchanged. It would change sampler draws for any seed whose run exhausts eight levels, the Python DEFAULTS mapping (read from Rust), the README defaults table and CHANGELOG, and admission bounds (Sampler::worst_case_target_evaluations grows about 4x). The coordinator's brief asked to note that a flip would bump ALGORITHM_REVISION and the fingerprint tests; the study records the precedent instead and leaves that policy call to the coordinator.

L.role: (c) descriptive long default funnel run (WP66's suggestion); no rule

run_order: F (seeds ascending; within a seed default then levels10), then P (models in house order; within a model seeds ascending; within a seed default then levels10), then L (seeds ascending). One process per cell, strictly sequential, four threads. Cell timeout 2,700 s (v7). An errored or timed-out cell is a failed cell (funnel: counts as |z| > 2; posteriordb: not passed, excluded from that model's geomean, which then drops the model per v7's rule). Never rerun; a host-killed driver is a recorded deviation.
funnel_harness: STUDIES/funnel_tail_deficit_v1/src/bin/funnel.rs (WP66) with three changes: the arm is the build (checked), an FNV-1a hash of the retained draws per chain and per cell, and default_max_refinement_levels recorded. Neal's 10-D funnel, house starts omega in {-3,-1,1,3}, x = 0, Metric::diagonal(), Limits::new().admit_worst_case(), 4 chains, 4 threads; statistic P(omega < -5) with the house MCSE z; per-class transition diagnostics as WP66.
posteriordb_harness: STUDIES/posteriordb_bench_v7_seed_extension/src/main.rs (WP62 = v7 oWALNUTS cell) with: build arms default / levels10 replacing defaults / dense; per-chain FNV-1a hash of the retained draws; per-chain counts over warmup + retained of selections of level 7, of levels >= 8, and of RefinementExhausted stops. Sampler::new() with only the run shape and admit_worst_case; Init::default() (best_of(16)) starts drawn as the sampler would. Driver metrics are v7's: draws constrained through BridgeStan with transformed parameters, gate parameters = posteriordb reference-draw columns, ArviZ 0.23.4 rank R-hat, bulk ESS, tail ESS (0.05, 0.95), mean MCSE; gradients = target calls including start search, warmup and sampling.

statistics.funnel: per arm: pooled P5 = mean of the 30 per-seed estimates, between-seed s.e. = sd / sqrt(30); paired seed differences levels10 - default; total retained divergences and exhaustions; median omega tail ESS; geomean min ESS per gradient; bit-identical cells by draws hash.
statistics.posteriordb: pass counts per arm out of 51; per model the median over the 3 seeds of min bulk ESS per gradient (warmup and start search included), ratio levels10 / default, geomean over the models whose 3 seeds are status ok on both arms (v7 rule); bit-identical cells (all four chains' retained-draw hashes equal); largest passing |z| (reported).

decision_rules.F1: funnel: total retained divergences of levels10 <= default's (block F).
decision_rules.F2: funnel: |pooled P5(levels10) - 0.0477903522728147| <= 2 x its between-seed s.e.
decision_rules.P1: posteriordb: levels10 pass count >= default pass count (out of 51).
decision_rules.P2: posteriordb: geomean over models of (median ESS/gradient levels10) / (median ESS/gradient default) >= 0.95.
decision_rules.D: build integrity: on the box, with the feature off, git diff 5af9903e of src/ and Cargo.toml / Cargo.lock at the repository root touches only the feature-gated constant (DEFAULT_MAX_REFINEMENT_LEVELS, value 8 off) and the Cargo feature entry, cargo test --release --test kernel_fingerprint passes, and the feature test passes in both builds.
decision_rules.verdict: SAFE (ten levels qualify as a default change; the flip itself is the coordinator's and is not applied here) iff F1, F2, P1, P2 and D all hold; otherwise NOT QUALIFIED, naming the failed clauses. Block L decides nothing.

predictions.Fa: funnel divergences fall by an order of magnitude: levels10 total x 10 <= default total (coordinator's prediction from WP66)
predictions.Fb: funnel pooled P5 unchanged: |paired mean difference| <= 1 paired s.e. (coordinator's prediction from WP66)
predictions.Fc: median omega tail ESS ratio levels10 / default in [0.9, 1.1]
predictions.Fd: funnel retained exhaustions fall by an order of magnitude
predictions.Pa: at least 25 of the 51 posteriordb cells are bit-identical across the two builds
predictions.Pc: levels10 passes the same number of posteriordb cells as default (equality)
predictions.Ld: block L (descriptive) pooled P5 within 1.5 between-seed s.e. of 0.0478
